item.title: Splendor Valley Road in McDowell County will be closed soon, expect delays
item.description: McDowell County, WV (WOAY) – Splendor Valley Road in McDowell County will be closed from 8 a.m. until 6 p.m. on Saturday, February 21. Crews will be replacing a short span bridge right at the beginning of the road. Drivers should expect delays in the area and should plan ahead. item.title: Fayette County drug dealer sentenced to at least 4 years in prison for delivery
item.description: Fayette County, WV (WOAY) – A Fayette County man has been sentenced to 4 to 60 years in prison for delivery. Phillip Moore, a 77-year-old man from Hilltop, was arrested for helping traffic drugs in Hilltop. Police raided his house in 2024 and found cocaine, scales, and U.S. currency.
